title: MCP Config
description: Manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configurations
confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete config "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
noConfigsDesc: Click the button above to add your first MCP server configuration
argsHelp: One argument per line, e.g. -y, minimax-mcp
envHelp: Environment variables required by the MCP server, e.g. API Key
nameHelp: Config name, config ID will be auto-generated
commandHelp: Command to start the MCP server
enabledHelp: Whether to enable this MCP server
noToolsDesc: Click 'Connect & Discover Tools' to get available tools
discoveringHint: Connecting and handshaking… stdio downloads dependencies on first run, up to ~45s (elapsed {elapsed}s)
discoverEmpty: Connected, but the server reported no tools
discoverTimeout: Timed out (no response for 60s); retry or check backend logs
unsupportedJsonFormat: Unsupported JSON format, must contain mcpServers field
connectionFailed: Failed to connect to MCP server
toolPermissionsHelp: Set the minimum permission level for each tool, only effective when Register as AI Tools is enabled. Lower pm value means higher permission.
roleGroupOwnerDesc: Group owner or channel owner and above
noPermissionRulesDesc: Click Add Default Permissions to set default value for all tools
discoverBeforeSubmit: Please click 'Connect & Discover Tools' to discover available tools before submitting
transportHelp: stdio starts a local server via command line. HTTP (Streamable) is the recommended remote transport. SSE is the legacy remote transport—use it only when the server still exposes /sse.
urlHelp: Remote MCP server URL. Streamable HTTP is usually …/mcp; legacy SSE is usually …/sse
urlRequired: URL is required for remote transports
headersHelp: HTTP headers sent in remote mode, e.g. Authorization
commandRequired: Command is required in stdio mode
generateProfileScheduled: Generation queued; refresh shortly to view
runtimeFix: stdio services run a local command. Install the runtime and restart gsuid_core, otherwise this service cannot start.
envBindableHelp: Checked = per-user credential: each user binds their own via DM; private tools run with the caller's credential. Unchecked = shared install-time value. Default all checked (fail-closed).
suggestSharedTip: This name looks like config, not a credential — you may uncheck user-bindable.
toolMutatingTip: Checked: calls require the caller's confirmation (irreversible ops like ordering/cancelling).
toolSensitiveTip: Args contain address/contact info — masked in group context summaries.
toolCredParamsTip: Which call arguments carry credentials (comma-separated). Removed from the model-visible signature and injected from the caller-bound credential at execution. Env/header credentials do not belong here.
bindUrlPlaceholder: Page URL where users get the token, shown in bind guide
bindHelpPlaceholder: Extra text appended to the bind guide (e.g. where to get the token)
bindAliasPlaceholder: Aliases accepted by the mcp绑定 command, comma-separated
allowAutonomousPrivateHelp: Allow autonomous private use — when on, scheduled/kanban tasks run private tools with the shared install credential; mutating calls still need human confirmation.
publicAckDesc: Once public, anyone can call it with the shared credential: results are bound to the install account (orders/quota charged there), private content may be exposed to the group, and third-party ToS may forbid shared use. Confirmed once and recorded.
bindingsHint: Users can self-bind by DMing the bot: mcp绑定 <service> <credential>.
revokeConfirmDesc: User {user} on {bot} immediately loses access to this service's private tools (must re-bind).
bindToMastersDesc: Creates bindings for the checked identities using the shared install credential (admin_install). Masters can still re-bind their own credential via DM.
candidatesEmpty: No 「主人用户」 rows in the subscribe table — a master appears after DMing the bot once; users can also self-bind via DM.
restoreDescTip: Description was overwritten by the server response. Click to restore the previously saved version.
